## Claim and review status

Full existential proof candidate for **30005613 / OWR-14297736-021**, rank 800, after **2/5** substantive approaches. Two independent adversarial mathematical AI audits returned **PASS without required corrections**. External expert review and historical novelty remain pending.

For every integer d >= 2, the candidate constructs a connected open quasi-conical tower of expanding cubes joined through positive shrinking windows. Its Dirichlet Laplacian has a complete orthonormal eigenbasis, spectrum and essential spectrum [0,infinity), no zero eigenvalue, and no absolutely continuous or singular continuous subspace.

**Cube widths and apertures are both chosen inductively.** There is no claim for arbitrary preassigned widths, smooth boundary, Neumann conditions, or positive-length passages. Pure point spectral type does not say every point of the spectral interval is an eigenvalue. Numerical aperture sizes are not computed.

## Mathematical artifacts

- [Complete unchanged proof](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/author/PROOF.md)
- [First independent audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/audit/AUDIT.md) and [analytic reconstruction](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/audit/ANALYTIC_CHECKS.md)
- [Second independent targeted audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/second_audit/SECOND_AUDIT.md)
- [Current verdict and scope](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/VERDICT.json)
- [Portable reproduction instructions](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005613/README.md)

The construction's geometry and finite-window convergence are credited to Krejcirik and Lotoreichik, [Quasi-conical domains with embedded eigenvalues](https://doi.org/10.1112/blms.13113). The source review records the question as open in [Open Problem 1 of the September 2026 survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28602v1). This is dated, bounded source evidence, not a first-resolution claim or exhaustive current literature certification.

## Verification

Normal, optimized and relocated replay passed, together with rejection tests for proof/audit/ZIP corruption, extra nested files, symlinks and unrelated queue changes. The recursive publication manifest covers all 38 payload files; the manifest itself makes 39 attempt files.

- Author: **4,187** finite controls, byte-identical frozen output
- First audit: **2,911** portable checks; **2,923** when the original author ZIP is also checked
- Full optional corpus/PDF input replay: **2,944**, byte-identical frozen output
- Second audit: **2,304** exact tail checks, recorded input fields reproduced
- Three unchanged ZIPs match all **31** extracted members; embedded author snapshot matches

These controls verify finite arithmetic and file integrity. They do **not** formally certify the infinite-dimensional PDE theorem, human peer review, historical novelty or editorial acceptance.

### Remote publication acceptance

Read back all **40 remote files** at commit 021518f6f65a86658f72e0b31bfa0814bf1aa25d and confirmed full byte identity, including the three ZIPs and the whole queue. The untruncated recursive attempt tree has 39 files; the commit comparison contains exactly those additions and the one queue modification. Remote-fetched normal, optimized, relocated and full optional-input replay all passed with byte-identical results. The exact three-cell queue reversal reproduces the original full queue hash.

At the final check, the PR remains open, draft and unmerged, with GitHub reporting a clean merge state. The exact head reports zero check runs, status contexts and workflow runs; this is **not a CI pass**.

### Immutable archives

- Author, 16,490 bytes: 2d15c0f1f7b094c92bafb6d2fed6d3b212c597adf9043c9f49c737a6f082e09e
- First audit, 45,053 bytes: 64bf89900a083fbc41176efd9766fde3a64397a5850207ce8e190eebbcdae6ea

## Repository scope

Based on main fb079fe5a515ee449967b93db4925919300f3fb3. Fresh bounded ID/topic PR, branch and actual attempt-directory checks found no earlier matching attempt.

Exactly this queue row's **Status**, **Turns** and **Findings** change to the qualified full-candidate result: claimed_solved, 2/5. Every other queue byte, including the stale embedded header, is preserved. No queue generator is run.

Only authored mathematics, audits, checker code/results, safe ZIPs and public verification metadata are added. Source PDFs, extracts, images, raw corpora and private coordination files are excluded. Freeze-time pending-audit/no-remote-write statements remain unchanged historical records.

Draft checkpoint only. No merge, release, DOI deposit or outreach.
